newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE announces pay raises to mark anniversary.
newsitem.headline: UAE announces pay raises to mark anniversary.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates president on Sunday issued a decree raising the salaries of federal government employees and members of the armed forces and security to mark the country's silver jubilee.
The decree, carried on the official WAM news agency, said the salaries and bonuses of federal government employees would be raised by 25 percent. The move also covers Abu Dhabi government employees.
Federal police and armed forces will enjoy a 15 percent pay rise and employees of the Gulf Arab state's security apparatus will see a 30 percent salary increase, the decree said.
All pay rises apply to retired employees, the decree said.
The UAE on December 2 will celebrate 25 years of independence from Britain and the 30th anniversary of Sheikh Zaid's accession as ruler of Abu Dhabi.
